base_branch.description: the pair's base branch, the public branch it works against: public_branch from the overlay config, main when the key is missing

parent.description: the feature this one is stacked on (--from), or main, the placeholder for base_branch whatever its name

checkout.description: the commands that get the branch into a checkout, run in order; each is an argv

checkout_hint.description: checkout as one shell line, the argvs joined with ' && '

local.description: what feature start did in the checkout it ran in; null for --plan

status.description: switched: on the branch now, tracking <remote>/<name>; fetched_only: fetched, not switched; skipped: not fetched

reason.description: why it didn't switch; empty when switched

remote.description: the checkout's remote for the shadow repo (for remote_differs, the remote named shadow that points elsewhere); empty when no checkout was looked at
